_how_to_edit: Meaning profiles for the semantic classifier (services/semantic_classifier.py). For each label: 'description' is one or two plain sentences saying what work it does and for whom; 'phrases' are themes, services and keywords funders would use; 'exclude' lists kinds of opportunity that look similar but must NOT get the label. Brand keyword inventories from services/brand_keywords.py are added automatically. Brand entries marked 'source' come from the brand teams' Brand Classification Input Forms. After editing, run scripts/semantic_eval.py to see whether it helped.

Swasti.description: Swasti is Catalyst's health catalyst — a not-for-profit society working to achieve public health outcomes for marginalised communities through research, community systems strengthening and direct delivery. It works with marginalised communities, informal workers, women, key populations, factory and gig workers, government health systems.
exclude: pharma procurement with no public health programming component

Vrutti.description: Vrutti is Catalyst's livelihood catalyst — a not-for-profit society that works with small producers and Farmer Producer Organisations to build income, market access and resilience. It works with smallholder and marginal farmers, FPOs/FPCs, rural women entrepreneurs, tribal communities, non-farm MSMEs.
exclude: Urban livelihoods with no agriculture link
pure microfinance/BFSI opportunities with no farmer or producer angle

Upfront.description: Upfront is Catalyst's workforce wellbeing catalyst, working with formal and informal workers to improve health, financial security, safety and agency through systems-change partnerships. It works with formal and informal workers — factory workers, fish and street vendors, construction workers, farmers, health workers — with a strong focus on women workers.
exclude: General corporate HR or wellness opportunities with no vulnerable-worker focus

Green Foundation.description: GREEN Foundation is Catalyst's agro-biodiversity organisation, working since 1994 to conserve indigenous seed varieties and support regenerative, sustainable farming. It works with small-scale and marginal farmers, rural farming communities.
phrases: organic certification facilitation through the Participatory Guarantee System
research and communication on sustainable agriculture
exclude: Commercial seed or agri-input business opportunities

Social Business.description: Enterprise-led development: social ventures, agribusiness and food businesses, market systems and market linkages for producers, value chains and post-harvest, farmer producer organisations and cooperatives, and the debt, equity and blended capital that funds them.
phrases: equity and debt investment in enterprises

Livelihood.description: Agriculture and rural livelihoods: raising incomes of farmers, smallholders, fishers, livestock keepers, artisans and rural households through farming, food systems, skills, self-help groups, producer organisations and rural development.
phrases: skills and vocational training for rural youth

Health.description: Health: public and primary health care, health systems, maternal and child health, nutrition, communicable and non-communicable disease, sexual and reproductive health, mental health, water sanitation and hygiene, and the health workforce.
phrases: primary health care and health systems strengthening
non-communicable diseases such as diabetes and cancer

E4C(Evidence for Change).description: Evidence for Change: research, monitoring and evaluation, impact assessment, baseline and endline studies, data collection and analysis, learning and knowledge management, and capacity building that produces evidence for programmes and policy.

Climate/Sustainability(ESG).description: Climate and sustainability: climate adaptation and mitigation, resilience, renewable and clean energy, biodiversity and conservation, natural resource management, disaster risk reduction, pollution and waste, and ESG.

Worker Wellbeing.description: Worker wellbeing: the health, safety, rights and welfare of workers in factories, supply chains and the informal economy, including decent work, wages, occupational health, gender equality at the workplace, migrant and domestic workers, and social protection for workers.
phrases: gender equality and safety at the workplace

Innovative Finance.description: Innovative finance: impact investing, blended and catalytic capital, outcome- and results-based financing, social and development impact bonds, microfinance and financial inclusion, and finance for enterprises and MSMEs.
phrases: access to finance for MSMEs and startups
